Subject: Budgetary request: FY28 prepay scenarios + split-pay option

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency and the routing controls. We're starting FY28 budget planning now and I need a set of budgetary pro forma options we can show our finance and procurement teams. High-level asks: 

- Three scenarios: (A) annual prepay for FY28 only; (B) 12-month commitment with split payments across FY28/FY29; (C) a 3-year prepay with staged ramp (lower in Y1, ramp to full in Y3) and a term discount.
- Please include implied per-token economics, expected savings vs monthly on-demand, and any assumptions (avg token length, embedding volume).
- We may need to split invoice/commit across fiscal years (FY28 runs Apr 1 2027–Mar 31 2028 for us) — include an option to split 60/40 and 40/60.
- We will likely require SOC2 evidence and basic contractual language (our GC will want a copy of the order form).

Attached is our usage estimate. Can you surface a pro forma that shows the staged-ramp pricing we discussed? Also, we want a ballpark on what a 10% vs 20% term discount would look like for the 3-year option.

Thanks,

Quick clarifying Qs so our pro forma matches your procurement needs:
- Do you need a legal redline now or is a draft order form sufficient for budget approval?
- Is the split-pay requirement an invoicing preference (Polaris prefers two fiscal invoices) or a true budget constraint that requires separate billing entities?
